newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Aberfoyle approves copper mine expansion.
newsitem.headline: Aberfoyle approves copper mine expansion.

text.p: Aberfoyle Ltd said on Tuesday it will go ahead with a A$125 million expansion of its Gunpowder copper mine in northwest Queensland.
The decision follows a 12-month feasibility study which began after Aberfoyle purchased the operation for A$18 million in June 1996.

Aberfoyle director Mike Eager said the project was expected to be completed in the third quarter of calendar 1998, and would produce 44,000 tonnes of cathode copper a year for six years, then 35,000 tonnes a year for the next four years.
The Gunpowder mine produced 7,832 tonnes of copper cathode in the 12 months to June 30, Aberfoyle said in its quarterly report.
Eager said the feasibility study had established chalcocite ore reserves and resources at the Esperanza and Mammoth orebodies to extend the life of the mine to at least 10 years.

Pilot plant trials had shown that a tank leaching/pressure oxidation process developed by Aberfoyle, when combined with existing solvent extraction and electrowinning processes, would yield a copper recovery of about 90 percent and maintain LME Grade A copper cathode quality.
The expansion project included preparing the Esperanza orebody for open pit mining, installing a plant and extending and upgrading parts of the existing plant, Aberfoyle said.
Exploration would be aimed at identifying further chalcocite reserves to fully utilise the plant's 44,000 tonnes per year capacity in the mine's later years, and to extend its life beyond 10 years.
Proved and probable reserves for the first six years were 4.1 million tones at the open-pit Esperanza, grading 7.2 percent copper.
The next four years were based on underground reserves at Mammoth of 2.6 million tonnes at 2.7 percent copper.
Aberfoyle said cash operating costs for the open pit mining phase were expected to be less than 45 U.S. cents a pound, comparing favourably with other low cost mines.
Drilling programmes early in the project would aim to turn inferred resources at Esperanza, Esperanza South and Mammoth into ore reserves.
